name: Google Places API
summary: Search and retrieve business listings, locations, and place details from Google Maps.
whatItDoes: Powers local B2B lead discovery by searching businesses by category, location, and radius — returns names, addresses, ratings, review counts, websites, and phone numbers for ICP matching.
privacyNotes: Public listing data only. Respect Google Maps Platform terms — do not republish bulk listings without attribution and usage compliance.
